pages.text: Checks if a button is pressed.$(br2)A block that is not a button raises INVALID_ARGUMENT. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the button is$(li)result $(1)result$() BOOLEAN: true if the button is pressed
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/GET_BUTTON$(br)  PARAMETER position button ;$(br)  RESULT result pressed$()
